improvements.title: Enhance Commenting Experience and Community Interaction Features
improvements.expectedEffect: Increase commentsLast7d and overall user interaction, fostering a more engaged community.
improvements.rationale: Low comment activity suggests users may not be motivated or find it easy to comment. Improving the UI/UX of the commenting feature, adding prompts, gamification, or introducing new community interaction features (e.g., Q&A, polls) could boost engagement. This addresses the critical lack of recent comments.

improvements.title: Improve New User Onboarding & Acquisition Strategies
improvements.expectedEffect: Increase newUsersLast7d and potentially activeUsersLast7d, driving platform growth.
improvements.rationale: Zero new users in 7 days indicates a problem with acquisition or onboarding. Enhancing the landing page, simplifying signup, improving content discoverability, and implementing targeted acquisition campaigns are crucial to address this critical deficit.

improvements.title: Implement Robust Tracking for Active Users and Recent Views
improvements.expectedEffect: Enable accurate measurement of user engagement and content consumption, providing essential data for future optimization strategies and trend analysis.
improvements.rationale: The current null values for `activeUsersLast7d` and `viewsLast7d` are significant data gaps. Implementing reliable tracking for these metrics is foundational for understanding user behavior, content performance, and the impact of other improvements.

improvements.title: Leverage AI Features for Enhanced Personalization and User Experience
improvements.expectedEffect: Increase user satisfaction, retention, and engagement by providing personalized content recommendations and AI-driven assistance.
improvements.rationale: The Gemini API is present, but its impact is not evident. Actively developing and promoting AI-driven features can differentiate the platform, provide unique value, and potentially drive engagement, addressing the overall low interaction.

expectedUserEffect: The proposed improvements aim to significantly increase user acquisition and engagement, leading to a more vibrant and interactive community. Enhanced content discovery and AI-driven personalization are expected to improve user satisfaction and retention.
